name: implement-approved-design

# Implement approved design

Use when `design_mode` is `conform`. Authoritative mockups win over agent
aesthetic defaults. The creative `frontend-design` procedure must not be the
primary procedure in conform mode. Inferences remain non-authoritative until
human validation.

1. Load the Design Contract and verify every authoritative reference is readable
   (not just mentioned).
2. Map and implement mandatory structure, text, components, states and viewports.
3. Search the design system inventory before creating any new component.
4. Stay inside `free_zones`; escalate gaps as clarification or decision requests.
5. Do not silently “improve” palette, layout hierarchy or copy against the mockup.
6. Produce implementation artifacts and plan visual evidence bound to route,
   state, viewport, reference id and commit SHA.
